implementation.enrollment: Supabase Auth validated by Node; nonce proof of possession, nonextractable IndexedDB P-256 keys, actor/account binding, one active device, revoke/replace invalidates pending sessions; no hardware attestation claim
implementation.agreement: strict existing H4 fields; exact serialized payload SHA-256; immutable unit/participants/keys/owner-version/mapping/policy/times
implementation.api: authenticated same-origin create/offer/frames/scan/seller-approve/confirm/cancel/status/recovery/receipt-proof with body bounds, exact-body idempotency and committed rate accounting
implementation.database: two applied checksummed migrations; restricted NOLOGIN role, forced RLS, nonpublic privileged functions, independent locked source checks, unique ownership/version commit and immutable audit
implementation.qr: both signed directions, 128-bit opaque handles/nonces, three consecutive distinct frames, approximately 120-second session/30-second consent, 5 updates/s local animation, scan-time validation, no network polling loop; no proximity claim
implementation.receipt: dedicated receipt-only authority; durable outbox, independent browser signature/device-approval verification, retry only signing after commit, same accepted transfer recovered
implementation.ui: One /chainproof page with signed-out account help, local browser readiness, guided buyer/seller views, seller names, current-step guidance, agreement review, both QR directions, explicit consents, folded record/device details, receipt/recovery and sign-out. No public signup in this demo.
